instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: USE .js EXTENSIONS FOR ALL FILES. NO .tsx or .ts files. Use JSDoc if types are needed.
CRITICAL: Always apply 'data-testid' to interactive elements for testing (e.g., data-testid='bottom-tab-home').
CRITICAL: Design for a mobile-first PWA experience (iPhone width 375px - 430px). Use 'max-w-md mx-auto overflow-hidden' to constrain desktop views to look like a phone screen.
Implement Framer Motion for all route changes, modal openings, and tab switches to mimic iOS native fluidity.
Do NOT use heavy solid colors. Use ambient mesh backgrounds (URL provided) and layer heavily blurred (backdrop-blur-2xl) glassmorphism cards over them.
For typography, import Cormorant Garamond from Google Fonts and use it specifically for headings and romantic quotes. Default to system sans for body text.
The application should feel deeply personal and premium, similar to the iOS Journal and Apple Music apps.
